preconditions.description: The number of towns n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of roads m must be between 0 and 100,000.
The number of different types of goods necessary s must be at least 1 and at most k, which is at most the minimum of n and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= k for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each town produces a type of goods that is between 1 and k.
All integers between 1 and k must occur at least once among the goods produced in the towns.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n numbers, one for each town.
Each number in the output must be non-negative, representing the minimum travel expenses.

postconditions.expression: all(int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each number in the output must not exceed n, as the maximum travel expense cannot exceed the number of towns.
